name: text-roll-navigation
title: Text Roll Navigation
description: A vertical menu of oversized uppercase words stacked tightly. Hovering a word splits it into letters that roll up and away while a fresh copy rises into place, starting from the centre out.
use: A portfolio or studio site wants a bold text-first menu where the hover motion is the personality.
avoid: Six links are hardcoded, the tall stack eats most of a viewport, and it assumes a mouse to reveal the effect.
a11y: Items are plain list text with no link or button roles, no focus states and no reduced-motion check. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Six huge white uppercase words in a narrow centred column on black, tightly leaded so the lines almost touch. There are no borders, icons or dividers, only the words.
behaves: Hovering a word sends each letter upward out of view while a duplicate rises from below with a small stagger from the middle outward. Leaving lets the word settle back.
customise: The six labels and links are hardcoded in the source; the exported TextRoll takes children and a centre flag but styling lives in classes.
weight: light: Six words with per-letter transforms on hover; idle when not hovered.
